verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports background automation via hosted/self-hosted continuous scanning, git hooks, CI integration, and continuous monitoring across Git/Jira/Slack/etc with alerting to Slack/Jira/webhooks, which can run unattended once configured. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific orchestration, scheduling controls, or explicit 'autonomous agent' tooling beyond scan triggers and hosted monitoring. Missing for 10: explicit autonomous/agentic scheduling framework, AI-native trigger/orchestration capabilities, and independent confirmation that hosted monitoring runs fully unattended without manual intervention.
